name: ruling-06-of-0-18-companion-missing-reselects
reference: spec 0.20, A switch on a decoded value; Encode: the case is the one decode would select from the bits the key's line wrote; decode: z = 4, else (empty). Re-encode: n is not held, so z's line writes zero bits and selects case 0, which writes v3 (absent: zero bits); the message gains a byte
